theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

top_news.title: Tech Stocks Sell Off on Earnings, Bitcoin Drops: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Technology stocks dropped for a second day as another round of disappointing earnings fueled a rotation out of the artificial intelligence trade. Bitcoin extended its decline.

top_news.title: Bayer Wins St. Louis Roundup Trial, Bolstering Settlement Push
top_news.summary: A jury in St. Louis rejected claims by three women who blamed Bayer AG’s Roundup weedkiller for their cancers, bolstering the company’s effort to contain the cost of tens of thousands of similar lawsuits in the US that it has offered to settle.

top_news.title: Dollar’s Rate-Fueled Rally Set to Ride Out US Midterm Gridlock
top_news.summary: The dollar’s rally may have enough momentum to shrug off the US midterm election, with high interest rates and a surge in AI-related spending drawing capital even if the vote delivers political gridlock.

top_news.title: Big Tech’s Deepening AI Funding Concerns Sink Asian Chip Stocks
top_news.summary: A crucial earnings season for the fate of the artificial intelligence trade is falling flat, fueling stock losses in global chipmakers as worries mount over soaring costs and the durability of demand.

top_news.title: Topix Overhaul Kicks Off: Three Things Investors Need to Know
top_news.summary: Japan Exchange Group Inc.’s first large-scale reshuffle of the Topix Index goes into effect Friday, part of the biggest overhaul in the benchmark’s history that may shrink the number of constituents by more than one-third.

top_news.title: PAG Agrees to Buy China Evergrande Unit for $514 Million
top_news.summary: Private equity firm PAG has agreed to buy a majority stake in Evergrande Property Services Group Ltd. for HK$4.03 billion ($514 million), according to a Hong Kong stock exchange filing, confirming a previous Bloomberg report.

top_news.title: Air Canada Reduces Profit Outlook Again on Jet Fuel Costs
top_news.summary: Air Canada slashed its full-year guidance for the second quarter in a row as high jet fuel prices proved worse than the country’s biggest airline expected.

top_news.title: Vale Iron Ore Output Trails Forecast on Serra Norte Curbs
top_news.summary: Vale SA’s iron ore production fell short of estimates in the third quarter as the world’s largest producer of the steelmaking ingredient faced challenges at a mine in northern Brazil.

top_news.title: JPMorgan Asset Sees Yuan Gaining 10% as Global Push Deepens
top_news.summary: China’s push to internationalize the yuan has entered a “steady, slow, but nonstop” phase that is likely to support further gains in the currency, according to JPMorgan Asset Management.

top_news.title: Blue Owl Looks to Raise Insurance Capital for AI Deals
top_news.summary: Blue Owl is telling investors that it needs more cash, particularly from deep-pocketed insurance firms, given the trillions of dollars needed to finance the artificial intelligence build-out.
